features.name: Animal Speaker
mechanics: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals only as rituals, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
mechanics: When activating Rage, choose one animal option to gain its benefit while raging.
Bear: Gain resistance to all damage types except force, necrotic, psychic, and radiant.
Eagle: When activating Rage and as a bonus action while raging, take both Disengage and Dash actions.
Wolf: Allies have advantage on attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you while you are raging.

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
mechanics: Choose one passive benefit; you can change your choice whenever you finish a long rest.
Owl: Gain darkvision out to 60 feet (or increase existing darkvision by 60 feet).
Panther: Gain a climb speed equal to your walking speed.
Salmon: Gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed.

features.name: Nature Speaker
mechanics: Cast Commune with Nature only as a ritual, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

features.name: Power of the Wilds
mechanics: When activating Rage, choose one animal option to gain its benefit while raging.
Falcon: Gain a fly speed equal to your walking speed while not wearing any armor.
Lion: Any enemy within 5 feet of you has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another barbarian with this option active.
Ram: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee attack, you can knock it prone without a saving throw.

features.name: Vitality of the Tree
mechanics: Vitality Surge: When you activate Rage, you gain temporary hit points equal to your barbarian level.

Life-Giving Force: At the start of each of your turns while raging, choose one creature within 10 feet of you to gain temporary hit points equal to roll of a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus; these temporary hit points vanish when your Rage ends.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
mechanics: While raging, when a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to force it to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier).

On a failed save, teleport the target to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of you or the nearest unoccupied space you can see, and you can reduce its speed to 0 until the end of the current turn.

features.name: Battering Roots
mechanics: During your turn, your reach increases by 10 feet with any Melee weapon that has the Heavy or Versatile property.
When you hit with such a weapon on your turn, you can activate the Push or Topple mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you are using with that weapon.

features.name: Travel Along the Tree
mechanics: When you activate Rage and as a bonus action while raging, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Once per Rage, you can increase the teleport distance to 150 feet and also bring up to 6 willing creatures within 10 feet of you, each teleporting to an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of your destination.

records.name: Path of the Zealot

features.name: Divine Fury
mechanics: While raging: the first creature you hit on each of your turns with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike takes extra damage = 1d6 + half your barbarian level.
Damage type: Necrotic or Radiant, your choice each time.

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
mechanics: Healing pool of d12s: 4 dice at level 3, 5 at level 6, 6 at level 12, 7 at level 17.
Bonus Action: spend any number of dice from the pool, roll them, regain Hit Points equal to the total.
The pool refills after a Long Rest.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
mechanics: Once per active Rage: when you fail a saving throw, reroll it with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus; you must use the new roll.

features.name: Zealous Presence
mechanics: Bonus Action: up to 10 other creatures of your choice within 60 feet gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn.
Once per Long Rest; you can also restore the use by expending one use of Rage (no action).

features.name: Rage of the Gods
mechanics: When you activate Rage, you can take a divine form for 1 minute or until you drop to 0 Hit Points. Once per Long Rest.
Divine form: Fly Speed equal to your Speed, you can hover; Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.
Revivification: when a creature within 30 feet would drop to 0 Hit Points, take a Reaction and expend one use of Rage to set its Hit Points to your barbarian level instead.

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
mechanics: Benefits apply while you are not wearing armor or wielding a Shield.
Dance Virtuoso: You have advantage on any Charisma (Performance) check you make that involves you dancing.
Unarmored Defense: Your base AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Charisma modifier.
Agile Strikes: When you expend a use of Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, a bonus action, or a reaction, you can make one unarmed strike as part of that same action, bonus action, or reaction.

Bardic Damage: You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of your unarmed strikes, and your unarmed strike deals bludgeoning damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die + your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Inspiring Movement
mechanics: When an enemy you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction and expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

One willing ally of your choice within 30 feet of you can also use their reaction to move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks; roll your Bardic Inspiration die to add nothing or movement as per rules (both move up to half speed without opportunity attacks).

features.name: Tandem Footwork
mechanics: When you roll Initiative and are not incapacitated, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration.
Roll your Bardic Inspiration die; you and each willing creature within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you gain a bonus to Initiative equal to the number rolled.

features.name: Leading Evasion
mechanics: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail.
If any creatures within 5 feet of you are making the same Dexterity saving throw, you can share this benefit with them for that save; you cannot use this feature if you are incapacitated.

records.name: College of Glamour

features.name: Beguiling Magic
mechanics: Always have the Charm Person and Mirror Image spells prepared.
Immediately after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell using a spell slot, you can force one creature you can see within 60 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC.
On a failed save, the target is Charmed or Frightened (your choice) for 1 minute; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Usable once per long rest, or you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to restore its use.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
mechanics: As a bonus action, expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and roll your Bardic Inspiration die.
Choose a number of creatures you can see within 60 feet of you up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1 creature).

Each target gains temporary hit points equal to 2 times the number rolled on the Bardic Inspiration die, and each can immediately use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
mechanics: Always have the Command spell prepared.
As a bonus action, cast Command without expending a spell slot and take on an unearthly appearance for 1 minute or until your concentration ends.
During this time, you can cast Command as a bonus action on each of your turns without expending a spell slot.
Any creature Charmed by you automatically fails its saving throw against the Command spell you cast with this feature.
Usable once per long rest, or you can expend a spell slot of level 3 or higher to restore its use.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
mechanics: As a bonus action, assume a majestic presence for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated.

Whenever any creature hits you with an attack roll for the first time on a turn, the attacker must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or the attack misses instead, as the creature recoils.
Usable once per short or long rest.

records.verify: Unbreakable Majesty: verify if the trigger in PHB 2024 is 'hits you for the first time on a turn' (turning a hit into a miss on failed Cha save) or 'targets you for the first time on a turn'.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
mechanics: A creature that has a Bardic Inspiration die from you can use it for one of two additional effects:

Defense: When the creature is hit by an attack roll, it can use its reaction to roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to its AC against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.
Offense: Immediately after the creature hits a target with an attack roll, it can roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to the attack's damage against the target.

features.name: Martial Training
mechanics: Gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and Shields.
You can use a Simple or Martial weapon as a spellcasting focus for your bard spells.

features.name: Extra Attack
mechanics: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
In addition, you can cast one of your cantrips that has a casting time of an action in place of one of those attacks.

features.name: Battle Magic
mechanics: After you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can make one attack with a weapon as a bonus action.

features.name: Light Domain Spells
mechanics: Always have domain spells prepared by cleric level: 3rd — Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, Scorching Ray, See Invisibility; 5th — Daylight, Fireball; 7th — Arcane Eye, Wall of Fire; 9th — Flame Strike, Scrying.

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
mechanics: As a Magic action, expend one use of Channel Divinity to dispel magical darkness within 30 feet of you.

Each hostile creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking radiant damage equal to 2d10 + your cleric level on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

features.name: Warding Flare
mechanics: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on that attack roll, provided the attacker is not immune to the Blinded condition.
Number of uses equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1); regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Improved Warding Flare
mechanics: You regain all expended uses of your Warding Flare when you finish a short or long rest.
Whenever you use Warding Flare, you can give the target of the triggering attack temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Corona of Light
mechanics: As a Magic action, emit an aura of sunlight for 1 minute or until you dismiss it (no action required).
Emit bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.
Enemies within the bright light have disadvantage on saving throws against your Radiance of the Dawn and any spell that deals fire or radiant damage.
Number of uses equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1); regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Trickery Domain Spells
mechanics: Always have domain spells prepared by cleric level: 3rd — Charm Person, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Pass without Trace; 5th — Hypnotic Pattern, Nondetection; 7th — Confusion, Dimension Door; 9th — Dominate Person, Modify Memory.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
mechanics: As a Magic action, choose yourself or a willing creature within 30 feet of you to have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
This blessing lasts until you finish a long rest or use this feature again to bless a different creature.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
mechanics: As a bonus action, expend one use of Channel Divinity to create a visual illusion of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you; it lasts for 1 minute (no concentration required) or until you dismiss it.
Cast Spells: You can cast spells as though you were in the illusion's space, using your own senses.
Distract: When both you and your illusion are within 5 feet of a creature that can see the illusion, you have advantage on attack rolls against that creature.
Move: As a bonus action, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet of you.

features.name: Trickster's Transposition
mechanics: Whenever you take the bonus action to create or move the illusion of your Invoke Duplicity, you can teleport, swapping places with the illusion.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
mechanics: Shared Distraction: When you and your allies make attack rolls against a creature within 5 feet of the Invoke Duplicity illusion, the attack rolls have advantage.
Healing Illusion: When the illusion ends, you or a creature of your choice within 5 feet of it regains a number of hit points equal to your cleric level.

features.name: War Domain Spells
mechanics: Always have domain spells prepared by cleric level: 3rd — Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith, Spiritual Weapon; 5th — Crusader's Mantle, Spirit Guardians; 7th — Fire Shield, Freedom of Movement; 9th — Hold Monster, Steel Wind Strike.

features.name: Guided Strike
mechanics: When you or a creature within 30 feet of you misses with an attack roll, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to give that roll a +10 bonus, potentially causing it to hit.
When you use this feature to benefit another creature's attack roll, you must take a reaction to do so.

features.name: War Priest
mechanics: As a bonus action, you can make one attack with a weapon or an unarmed strike.
Number of uses equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1); regain all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: War God's Blessing
mechanics: You can expend one use of Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon rather than expending a spell slot.
When you cast either spell in this way, the spell does not require concentration, and it lasts for 1 minute.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
mechanics: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

features.name: Circle Forms
mechanics: Max Challenge Rating of Wild Shape beast forms equals your Druid level divided by 3 (round down).
While in a Wild Shape form, your AC equals 13 + your Wisdom modifier if that is higher than the beast's normal AC.
When you assume a Wild Shape form, you gain temporary hit points equal to 3 times your Druid level.

features.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
mechanics: Always prepared subclass spells by Druid level: 3rd — Cure Wounds, Moonbeam, Starry Wisp; 5th — Conjure Animals; 7th — Fount of Moonlight; 9th — Mass Cure Wounds.
You can cast your prepared Circle of the Moon spells while you are in a Wild Shape form.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
mechanics: While in a Wild Shape form, your attacks can deal their normal damage type or radiant damage (your choice on each hit).
While in a Wild Shape form, you add your Wisdom modifier to your Constitution saving throws.

features.name: Moonlight Step
mechanics: Bonus Action: teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, and you have advantage on the next attack roll you make before the end of this turn.
Usable a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per long rest; you can also restore a use by expending a level 2+ spell slot (no action required).

features.name: Lunar Form
mechanics: Once per turn when you hit a target with an attack while in a Wild Shape form, you deal an extra 2d10 radiant damage.
When you use Moonlight Step, you can also teleport one willing creature within 10 feet of you to an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of your destination space.

features.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
mechanics: Always prepared subclass spells by Druid level: 3rd — Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter, Thunderwave; 5th — Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing; 7th — Control Water, Ice Storm; 9th — Conjure Elemental, Hold Monster.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
mechanics: Bonus Action: expend one use of Wild Shape to manifest a 5-foot Emanation around you for 10 minutes (ends early if you become Incapacitated, manifest it again, or dismiss it with no action required).
When you manifest the Emanation and as a Bonus Action on subsequent turns, choose another creature you can see in the Emanation.

The target makes a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, it takes cold damage equal to a number of d6s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1d6), and if it is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from you.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
mechanics: The size of your Wrath of the Sea Emanation increases to 10 feet.
You gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Stormborn
mechanics: While your Wrath of the Sea is active, you gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.
While your Wrath of the Sea is active, you have resistance to cold, lightning, and thunder damage.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
mechanics: When you activate Wrath of the Sea, you can manifest the Emanation around one willing creature within 60 feet of you instead of yourself; that creature gains all benefits of the Emanation and uses your spell save DC and Wisdom modifier for it.
You can manifest the Emanation around both yourself and that willing creature if you expend two uses of Wild Shape instead of one when activating Wrath of the Sea.

features.name: Star Map
mechanics: You gain a Tiny object that serves as a spellcasting focus for your Druid spells; if lost or destroyed, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony to create a replacement during a short or long rest.
While holding the map, you have the Guidance and Guiding Bolt spells prepared.
You can cast Guiding Bolt without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.

features.name: Starry Form
mechanics: Bonus Action: expend one use of Wild Shape to take a luminous Starry Form for 10 minutes (ends early if you dismiss it with no action, become Incapacitated, or use this feature again). You shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet, and you choose one constellation:
Archer: When you activate this form and as a Bonus Action on subsequent turns while it lasts, make a ranged spell attack up to 60 feet that deals 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier radiant damage on a hit.
Chalice: Whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores hit points to a creature, you or another creature within 30 feet of you regains hit points equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier.
Dragon: When you make an Intelligence or a Wisdom check or a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration on a spell, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
mechanics: Whenever you finish a long rest, roll any die: an even number gives Weal, and an odd number gives Woe.
Reaction when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is about to make a D20 Test: roll 1d6 and add it to the total (Weal) or subtract it from the total (Woe).
Usable a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
mechanics: The 1d8 of Archer and Chalice becomes 2d8.
While the Dragon constellation is active, you have a Fly Speed of 20 feet and can hover.
At the start of each of your turns while in Starry Form, you can change which constellation is active.

features.name: Full of Stars
mechanics: While in your Starry Form, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

features.name: Combat Superiority
mechanics: You learn 3 maneuvers of your choice; you learn 2 additional maneuvers at Fighter levels 7, 10, and 15, and can replace 1 maneuver you know whenever you gain a Fighter level. You can use only one maneuver per attack.
You gain 4 Superiority Dice, which are d8s (expended when used, regained on a short or long rest). You gain an additional Superiority Die at Fighter level 7 (total 5) and level 15 (total 6).
Maneuver save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).
Ambush: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll, expend 1 Superiority Die and add the roll to the d20 roll (unless you are Incapacitated).

Bait and Switch: When you are within 5 feet of a willing creature (not Incapacitated) on your turn, expend 1 Superiority Die and spend 5 feet of movement to swap places with it (no Opportunity Attacks provoked). Roll the Superiority Die: either you or that creature gains a bonus to AC equal to the roll until the start of your next turn.

Brace: When a creature you can see moves into the reach you have with a Melee weapon you are holding, use your Reaction and expend 1 Superiority Die to make 1 attack against it with that weapon; on a hit, add the Superiority Die to the weapon's damage roll.

Commander's Strike: When you take the Attack action on your turn, forgo 1 of your attacks and use a Bonus Action plus 1 Superiority Die to direct a willing ally who can see or hear you. That ally can immediately use its Reaction to make 1 weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, adding the Superiority Die to the damage roll on a hit.
Commanding Presence: When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check, expend 1 Superiority Die and add the roll to your check.

Disarming Attack: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, expend 1 Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll; the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or drop 1 object of your choice that it is holding.

Distracting Strike: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, expend 1 Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll; the next attack roll against the target by an attacker other than you has advantage if made before the start of your next turn.

Evasive Footwork: Bonus Action: expend 1 Superiority Die and take the Disengage action; you also roll the die and add the number rolled to your AC until the start of your next turn (cannot use while Incapacitated).

Feinting Attack: Bonus Action: expend 1 Superiority Die and choose 1 creature within 5 feet of you. You have advantage on your next attack roll against that creature this turn, and if that attack hits, add the Superiority Die to the damage roll.

Goading Attack: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, expend 1 Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll; the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on all attack rolls against targets other than you until the end of your next turn.

Lunging Attack: Bonus Action: expend 1 Superiority Die and take the Dash action. If you move at least 5 feet in a straight line immediately before hitting with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on this turn, add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll.

Maneuvering Attack: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, expend 1 Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll, and choose 1 willing creature who can see or hear you; that creature can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target of your attack.

Menacing Attack: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, expend 1 Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll; the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

Parry: When another creature damages you with a melee attack, use your Reaction and expend 1 Superiority Die to reduce the damage by the number rolled on your Superiority Die plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).
Precision Attack: When you miss with an attack roll, expend 1 Superiority Die, roll it, and add the result to the attack roll, potentially turning the miss into a hit.

Pushing Attack: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll, expend 1 Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll; the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet straight away from you.

Rally: Bonus Action: expend 1 Superiority Die and choose 1 ally within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you; that creature gains temporary hit points equal to the Superiority Die roll + half your Fighter level (round down).

Riposte: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, use your Reaction and expend 1 Superiority Die to make 1 melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against the creature; on a hit, add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll.

Sweeping Attack: When you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, expend 1 Superiority Die and choose another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach; if the original attack roll would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the number you roll on your Superiority Die (same damage type as the attack).
Tactical Assessment: When you make an Intelligence (History or Investigation) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check, expend 1 Superiority Die and add the roll to the ability check.

Trip Attack: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll, expend 1 Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll; the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.

features.name: Student of War
mechanics: You gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools of your choice, and you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice from the skills available to Fighters at level 1.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
mechanics: Bonus Action: choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you; you learn whether that creature has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities, and what they are.
Usable once per long rest, or you can restore its use by expending 1 Superiority Die (no action required).

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
mechanics: Your Superiority Die becomes a d10.

features.name: Relentless
mechanics: Once per turn, when you use a maneuver, you can roll 1d8 and use the number rolled instead of expending a Superiority Die.

features.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
mechanics: Your Superiority Die becomes a d12.

features.name: Spellcasting
mechanics: You gain Wizard spellcasting using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability (spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier; spell attack modifier = proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier) and can use an Arcane Focus as a spellcasting focus.
Cantrips known from the Wizard spell list: 2 at level 3, increasing to 3 at Fighter level 10. Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace 1 cantrip with another Wizard cantrip.

Prepared Wizard spells (no school restrictions in 2024) and spell slots by Fighter level: 3rd — 3 spells (2 1st-level slots); 4th — 4 spells (3 1st); 7th — 5 spells (4 1st, 2 2nd); 8th — 6 spells; 10th — 7 spells (4 1st, 3 2nd); 11th — 8 spells; 13th — 9 spells (4 1st, 3 2nd, 2 3rd); 14th — 10 spells; 16th — 11 spells (4 1st, 3 2nd, 3 3rd); 19th — 12 spells (4 1st, 3 2nd, 3 3rd, 1 4th); 20th — 13 spells. You can replace 1 prepared spell whenever you gain a Fighter level.

features.name: War Bond
mechanics: You can perform a 1-hour ritual during a short rest to bond with a weapon (up to 2 bonded weapons at a time; bonding a 3rd breaks the bond with 1 of the previous ones).
You cannot be disarmed of a bonded weapon unless you have the Incapacitated condition.
Bonus Action: teleport 1 bonded weapon to your hand if it is on the same plane of existence.

features.name: War Magic
mechanics: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with a casting of one of your Wizard cantrips that has a casting time of an action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
mechanics: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
mechanics: When you use your Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see (either before or after the additional action).

features.name: Improved War Magic
mechanics: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace two of the attacks with a casting of one of your level 1 or level 2 Wizard spells that has a casting time of an action.

records.name: Psi Warrior

features.name: Psionic Power
mechanics: You have Psionic Energy Dice: 4d6 at level 3; the die size and count scale by Fighter level: 5th — 6d8; 9th — 6d8; 11th — 8d10; 13th — 10d10; 17th — 12d12. You regain all expended dice on a long rest, and you regain 1 expended die whenever you finish a short rest.

Protective Field: Reaction when you or another creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage: expend 1 Psionic Energy Die, roll it, and reduce the damage taken by the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum reduction of 1).

Psionic Strike: Once on each of your turns, immediately after you hit a target within 30 feet of you with an attack and deal damage to it with a weapon, you can expend 1 Psionic Energy Die, roll it, and deal force damage to the target equal to the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier.

Telekinetic Movement: Magic action: choose one Loose object that is Large or smaller or one willing creature other than yourself that you can see within 30 feet of you, and move it up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Usable once per short or long rest, or you can restore its use by expending 1 Psionic Energy Die (no action required).

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
mechanics: Psi-Powered Leap: Bonus Action: gain a Fly Speed equal to twice your Speed until the end of the current turn. Usable once per short or long rest, or you can restore its use by expending 1 Psionic Energy Die (no action required).

Telekinetic Thrust: When you deal damage to a target with your Psionic Strike, you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier). On a failed save, you can give the target the Prone condition or move it up to 10 feet horizontally.

features.name: Guarded Mind
mechanics: You have resistance to psychic damage.
If you start your turn with the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can expend 1 Psionic Energy Die (no action required) and end every effect on yourself giving you those conditions.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
mechanics: Bonus Action: choose creatures, including yourself, within 30 feet of you, up to a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1 creature); each chosen creature has Half Cover (+2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws) for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition.
Usable once per long rest, or you can restore its use by expending 1 Psionic Energy Die (no action required).

features.name: Telekinetic Master
mechanics: You always have the Telekinesis spell prepared; you can cast it without a spell slot or components, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.
On each of your turns while you maintain concentration on Telekinesis, including the turn when you cast it, you can make 1 attack with a weapon as a Bonus Action.
Once you cast Telekinesis with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest unless you restore its use by expending 1 Psionic Energy Die (no action required).

records.verify: Verify exact Psionic Energy Die count progression in English mechanics string at level 9 (8d8).

records.name: Warrior of Mercy

features.name: Hand of Harm
mechanics: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can expend 1 Focus Point to deal extra necrotic damage equal to 1 roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Hand of Healing
mechanics: Magic action: expend 1 Focus Point and touch a creature to restore hit points equal to 1 roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier.
When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can replace one of the Unarmed Strikes with a use of Hand of Healing without expending a Focus Point for the healing.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
mechanics: You gain proficiency in the Insight and Medicine skills, and you gain proficiency with the Herbalism Kit.

features.name: Physician's Touch
mechanics: When you use Hand of Healing on a creature, you can also end one of the following conditions on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.
When you use Hand of Harm on a creature, you can also subject that creature to the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
mechanics: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace each of the Flurry's Unarmed Strikes with a use of Hand of Healing without expending Focus Points for the healing.

When you make an Unarmed Strike with Flurry of Blows, you can use Hand of Harm with that strike without expending the Focus Point for Hand of Harm (still limited to once per turn). You can use these benefits a total number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
mechanics: Magic action: touch the corpse of a creature that died within the past 24 hours and expend 5 Focus Points. The creature returns to life with hit points equal to 4d10 + your Wisdom modifier, and any Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned conditions on it end.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

records.verify: Verify whether PHB 2024 Flurry of Healing and Harm limits free uses (both healing and harm or only harm) to Wisdom modifier per long rest.

features.name: Shadow Arts
mechanics: You can expend 1 Focus Point to cast the Darkness spell without spell components (using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability).

You can see within the spell's area of Darkness created by this feature, and while within your turn, you can move its area of Darkness up to 60 feet to a space within 60 feet of yourself (no action required).
You gain Darkvision with a range of 60 feet; if you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet.
You know the Minor Illusion cantrip (Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it).

features.name: Shadow Step
mechanics: Bonus Action while entirely within Dim Light or Darkness: teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness.
You then have advantage on the next melee attack you make before the end of the turn.

features.name: Improved Shadow Step
mechanics: When you use your Shadow Step, you can expend 1 Focus Point to remove the requirement that you must start and end in Dim Light or Darkness.
As part of that same Bonus Action, you can make an Unarmed Strike immediately after you teleport.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
mechanics: Magic action while entirely within Dim Light or Darkness: expend 3 Focus Points to shroud yourself in shadows for 1 minute (ends early if you have the Incapacitated condition or end your turn in Bright Light).

While shrouded: you have the Invisible condition; you are partially incorporeal and can move through occupied spaces as if they were Difficult Terrain (taking 1d10 force damage if you end your turn in such a space); and you can use your Flurry of Blows without expending any Focus Points.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
mechanics: At the start of your turn, you can expend 1 Focus Point to imbue yourself with elemental energy for 10 minutes (ends early if you have the Incapacitated condition). While active, you gain the following benefits:
Reach: When you make an Unarmed Strike, your reach is 10 feet greater than normal (total 15 feet).

Elemental Strikes: Whenever you hit with your Unarmed Strike, you can cause it to deal acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (your choice) instead of its normal damage type. When you deal one of these types with an Unarmed Strike, you can also force the target to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier); on a failed save, you can move the target up to 10 feet toward or away from you.

features.name: Manipulate Elements
mechanics: You know the Elementalism cantrip (Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it).

features.name: Elemental Burst
mechanics: Magic action: expend 2 Focus Points to cause elemental energy to burst in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of yourself.

Choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Each creature in the Sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier), taking damage of the chosen type equal to three rolls of your Martial Arts die on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Stride of the Elements
mechanics: While your Elemental Attunement is active, you also have a Fly Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Elemental Epitome
mechanics: While your Elemental Attunement is active, you gain the following additional benefits:
Damage Resistance: You have resistance to one of the following damage types of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. You can change this choice at the start of each of your turns.

Destructive Stride: When you use your Step of the Wind, your Speed increases by 20 feet until the end of the turn, and for that duration, whenever you enter a space within 5 feet of a creature, you can deal damage to it equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder; a creature can take this damage only once per turn).
Empower Strikes: Once on each of your turns, you can deal extra damage to a target equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die when you hit it with an Unarmed Strike (same damage type as that strike).

records.name: Oath of Glory

features.name: Oath of Glory Spells
mechanics: Always prepared subclass spells by Paladin level: 3rd — Guiding Bolt, Heroism; 5th — Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon; 9th — Haste, Protection from Energy; 13th — Compulsion, Freedom of Movement; 17th — Legend Lore, Yolande's Regal Presence.

features.name: Inspiring Smite
mechanics: Immediately after you cast Divine Smite, you can expend 1 use of Channel Divinity (no extra action required) to distribute temporary hit points equal to 2d8 + your Paladin level among creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you (can include yourself).

features.name: Peerless Athlete
mechanics: Bonus action: expend 1 use of Channel Divinity; duration 1 hour.
While active, you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and the distance of your Long and High Jumps increases by 10 feet (costs movement as normal).

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
mechanics: Your Speed increases by 10 feet.
Whenever an ally enters your Aura of Protection for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, that ally's Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

features.name: Glorious Defense
mechanics: Reaction when you or a creature you can see within 10 feet of you is hit by an attack roll: grant a bonus to the target's AC against that attack equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1).
If the attack misses because of this bonus, you can make 1 weapon attack against the attacker as part of the same Reaction, provided the attacker is within your weapon's reach or range.
Uses equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1); regain all expended uses after a Long Rest.

features.name: Living Legend
mechanics: Bonus action: empower yourself for 10 minutes. Once per Long Rest, or expend a level 5 spell slot to use again.
Charismatic: you have Advantage on all Charisma checks.
Saving Throw Reroll: if you fail a saving throw, you can take a Reaction to reroll it and must use the new roll.
Unerring Strike: once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack and miss, you can cause that attack to hit instead.

records.verify: Verify whether Peerless Athlete in PHB 2024 still doubles carrying/push/drag/lift capacity alongside the 10-foot jump increase, and whether Living Legend duration is 10 minutes or 1 minute.

records.name: Oath of the Ancients

features.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
mechanics: Always prepared subclass spells by Paladin level: 3rd — Ensnaring Strike, Speak with Animals; 5th — Misty Step, Moonbeam; 9th — Plant Growth, Protection from Energy; 13th — Ice Storm, Stoneskin; 17th — Commune with Nature, Tree Stride.

features.name: Nature's Wrath
mechanics: Magic action: expend 1 use of Channel Divinity to conjure spectral vines around creatures of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of you.

Each target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition for 1 minute; a Restrained target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

features.name: Aura of Warding
mechanics: You and allies within your Aura of Protection have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
mechanics: When you are reduced to 0 hit points and not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead, and you regain hit points equal to 3 times your Paladin level. Once per Long Rest.
You cannot be aged magically, and you suffer none of the drawbacks of old age.

features.name: Elder Champion
mechanics: Bonus action: transform for 1 minute. Once per Long Rest, or expend a level 5 spell slot to use again.
Diminish Defiance: enemies within your Aura of Protection have Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells and Channel Divinity options.
Regeneration: at the start of each of your turns, you regain 10 hit points.
Swift Spells: whenever you cast a Paladin spell that has a casting time of an action, you can cast it using a Bonus Action instead.

records.verify: Verify whether Undying Sentinel heals 3x Paladin level upon triggering in PHB 2024, or only drops to 1 HP.

features.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
mechanics: Always prepared subclass spells by Paladin level: 3rd — Bane, Hunter's Mark; 5th — Hold Person, Misty Step; 9th — Haste, Protection from Energy; 13th — Banishment, Dimension Door; 17th — Hold Monster, Scrying.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
mechanics: When you take the Attack action, you can expend 1 use of Channel Divinity (no extra action required) to utter a vow against a creature you can see within 30 feet of you.
You have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature for 1 minute or until you use this feature again.
If the creature drops to 0 hit points before the vow ends, you can transfer the vow to a different creature within 30 feet of you (no action required).

features.name: Relentless Avenger
mechanics: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, you can reduce the creature's Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn.
You can then move up to half your Speed as part of the same Reaction without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
mechanics: Immediately after a creature under the effect of your Vow of Enmity hits or misses with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to make a melee attack against that creature if it is within your reach.

features.name: Avenging Angel
mechanics: Bonus action: transform for 10 minutes. Once per Long Rest, or expend a level 5 spell slot to use again.
Flight: you sprout spectral wings and gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

Frightful Aura: whenever an enemy starts its turn within your Aura of Protection or enters it for the first time on a turn, that enemy must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.
Attack rolls against the Frightened creature have Advantage.

records.name: Beast Master

features.name: Primal Companion
mechanics: Summon a primal beast: Beast of the Land, Beast of the Sea, or Beast of the Sky. It is friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. It vanishes if you die.

Beast stats: AC = 13 + your Wisdom modifier; Hit Points = 5 + 5 times your Ranger level (or 4 + 4 times your Ranger level for Beast of the Sky); uses your Proficiency Bonus (+PB) on any ability check or saving throw it makes.

Beast of the Land: Speed 40 ft., Climb 40 ft.; Maul attack (melee, +Spell Attack Modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8 + 2 + Wisdom modifier slashing/bludgeoning/piercing damage; if it moved at least 20 ft. straight toward the target before hitting, takes extra 1d6 damage and Large or smaller target is knocked Prone).

Beast of the Sea: Speed 5 ft., Swim 60 ft., Amphibious; Binding Strike attack (melee, +Spell Attack Modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d6 + 2 + Wisdom modifier piercing/bludgeoning damage, and target is Grappled, escape DC = your Spell Save DC).

Beast of the Sky: Speed 10 ft., Fly 60 ft., Flyby (doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when flying out of reach); Shred attack (melee, +Spell Attack Modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4 + 3 + Wisdom modifier slashing damage).

In combat, the beast acts during your turn. It can move and use its Reaction on its own, but takes only the Dodge action unless you take a Bonus Action to command it to take another action. You can also sacrifice one of your attacks when you take the Attack action to command the beast to take the Beast's Strike action.

Restoration: if the beast has died within the last hour, you can take a Magic action and expend a spell slot to revive it after 1 minute with all its hit points restored. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can summon a different primal beast (appearing within 5 feet of you).

features.name: Exceptional Training
mechanics: When you take a Bonus Action to command your Primal Companion beast to take an action, you can also command it to take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action using its Bonus Action.
Whenever the beast hits with an attack roll, it can deal Force damage or its normal damage type (your choice).

features.name: Bestial Fury
mechanics: When you command your Primal Companion beast to take the Beast's Strike action, the beast can use it twice.
Once per turn, the first time the beast hits a creature under the effect of your Hunter's Mark spell, the beast deals extra Force damage equal to the bonus damage of that spell (1d6).

features.name: Share Spells
mechanics: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your Primal Companion beast with the spell if the beast is within 30 feet of you.

records.verify: Verify whether Primal Companion stat blocks in PHB 2024 use Wisdom modifier or Proficiency Bonus for AC and damage rolls.

records.name: Fey Wanderer

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
mechanics: When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn.
The extra damage increases to 1d6 when you reach Ranger level 11.

features.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
mechanics: Always prepared subclass spells by Ranger level: 3rd — Charm Person; 5th — Misty Step; 9th — Summon Fey; 13th — Dimension Door; 17th — Mislead.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
mechanics: Whenever you make a Charisma check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1).
You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Deception, Performance, or Persuasion.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
mechanics: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition.

Reaction when you or a creature you can see within 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition: force a different creature you can see within 120 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your Spell Save DC.
On a failed save, the target is Charmed or Frightened by you (your choice) for 1 minute; the target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
mechanics: You can cast Summon Fey without a material component.
You can also cast it once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.
Whenever you start casting Summon Fey, you can modify it so that it doesn't require Concentration; if you do so, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
mechanics: You can cast Misty Step without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Whenever you cast Misty Step, you can bring along one willing creature you can see within 5 feet of you; that creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of your destination space.

records.verify: Verify whether PHB 2024 9th-level Fey Wanderer spell is Summon Fey or Dispel Magic (in 2024 it was updated to Summon Fey to match the level 11 feature).

features.name: Dread Ambusher
mechanics: Initiative Bonus: you add your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) to your Initiative rolls.
Ambusher's Leap: at the start of your first turn of each combat, your Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

Dreadful Strike: when you attack a creature and hit it with a weapon, you can deal an extra 2d6 Psychic damage. You can use this benefit only once per turn, you can use it a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
mechanics: Always prepared subclass spells by Ranger level: 3rd — Disguise Self; 5th — Rope Trick; 9th — Fear; 13th — Greater Invisibility; 17th — Seeming.

features.name: Umbral Sight
mechanics: You gain Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision when you gain this feature, its range increases by 60 feet.
While entirely in Darkness, you have the Invisible condition to any creature that relies on Darkvision to see you in that Darkness.

features.name: Iron Mind
mechanics: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.
If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
mechanics: The Psychic damage of your Dreadful Strike becomes 2d8.
When you use the Dreadful Strike effect of your Dread Ambusher feature, you can choose one of the following additional effects:
Sudden Strike: you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within your weapon's reach or range.

Mass Fear: the target and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a Wisdom saving throw against your Spell Save DC; on a failed save, a creature has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
mechanics: Reaction when a creature makes an attack roll against you: impose Disadvantage on that roll.
Whether the attack hits or misses, you can then teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

features.name: Spellcasting
mechanics: Spellcasting ability is Intelligence (Spell Save DC = 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Intelligence modifier; Spell Attack Modifier = Proficiency Bonus + Intelligence modifier). You can use an Arcane Focus as a spellcasting focus.

Cantrips: you know Mage Hand and 2 other cantrips of your choice from the Wizard spell list. You learn 1 additional Wizard cantrip at Rogue level 10. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one of your cantrips from this feature with another Wizard cantrip.

Spell Slots (1/3 caster progression): Level 3 — two 1st; Level 4 — three 1st; Level 7 — four 1st, two 2nd; Level 10 — four 1st, three 2nd; Level 13 — four 1st, three 2nd, two 3rd; Level 16 — four 1st, three 2nd, three 3rd; Level 19 — four 1st, three 2nd, three 3rd, one 4th.

Prepared Spells from the Wizard spell list (no school restriction in 2024): 3 spells at level 3, increasing by ability progression up to 13 spells at level 20 (3 at 3rd, 4 at 4th, 5 at 7th, 6 at 8th, 7 at 10th, 8 at 11th, 9 at 13th, 10 at 14th, 11 at 16th, 12 at 19th, 13 at 20th). Whenever you gain a Rogue level, you can replace one prepared spell with another Wizard spell for which you have spell slots.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
mechanics: When you cast Mage Hand, you can cast it as a Bonus Action, and you can make the spectral hand Invisible.
You can control the hand as a Bonus Action, and through it you can make Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks (including using Thieves' Tools to pick locks and disarm traps) at range.
You can perform these tasks without being noticed by a creature if you succeed on a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the creature's Wisdom (Perception) check.

features.name: Magical Ambush
mechanics: If you have the Invisible condition when you cast a spell on a creature, that creature has Disadvantage on any saving throw it makes against the spell on the same turn.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
mechanics: When you use the Trip Cunning Strike option on a creature, you can also use that option on another creature within 5 feet of your Mage Hand spectral hand.

features.name: Spell Thief
mechanics: Reaction immediately after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area of effect: force the creature to make an Intelligence saving throw against your Spell Save DC.

On a failed save, you negate the spell's effect against you, and if the spell is at least level 1 and of a level you can cast (up to level 4), you steal the knowledge of the spell for 8 hours (the caster can't cast that spell until the 8 hours have passed).
While you know the stolen spell, you can cast it using your spell slots. Once you steal a spell with this feature, you can't use this feature again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Assassinate
mechanics: Initiative: you have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

Surprising Strikes: during the first round of each combat, you have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet. If your Sneak Attack hits any target during that round, the target takes extra damage of the weapon's type equal to your Rogue level.

features.name: Assassin's Tools
mechanics: You gain proficiency with the Disguise Kit and the Poisoner's Kit, and you gain those tool kits.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
mechanics: Masterful Mimicry: you can unerringly mimic another person's speech, handwriting, or both if you have spent at least 1 hour studying them.
Roving Aim: your Speed isn't reduced to 0 by using Steady Aim.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
mechanics: When you use the Poison option of your Cunning Strike, the target also takes 2d6 Poison damage whenever it fails the saving throw.
This damage ignores Resistance to Poison damage.

features.name: Death Strike
mechanics: When you hit with your Sneak Attack on the first round of a combat, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your Proficiency Bonus), or the attack's damage is doubled against the target.

features.name: Psionic Power
mechanics: Psionic Energy Dice: you have a pool of Psionic Energy Dice, which are d6s. Die size increases by Rogue level: d8 at level 5, d10 at level 11, d12 at level 17.
Pool size by Rogue level: 4 dice at level 3, 6 at level 5, 8 at level 9, 10 at level 13, 12 at level 17.
Recovery: you regain all expended Psionic Energy Dice when you finish a Long Rest, and you regain 1 expended die when you finish a Short Rest.

Psi-Bolstered Knack: if you fail an ability check using a skill or tool with which you have proficiency, you can roll one Psionic Energy Die and add the number rolled to the check, potentially turning failure into success. The die is expended only if the roll then succeeds.

Psychic Whispers: Magic action to choose up to your Proficiency Bonus in visible creatures within 120 feet. Roll a Psionic Energy Die; for a number of hours equal to the number rolled, you and the chosen creatures can speak telepathically with each other while within 1 mile of each other. First use per Long Rest is free; subsequent uses expend 1 Psionic Energy Die.

features.name: Psychic Blades
mechanics: Whenever you take the Attack action or make an Opportunity Attack, you can manifest a Psychic Blade in your free hand and make the attack with that blade.
Blade stats: Simple Melee Weapon, 1d6 Psychic damage + ability modifier, Finesse and Thrown (60/120 feet) properties, Vex mastery property. The blade vanishes immediately after it hits or misses.

Bonus Action Attack: after you attack with the blade on your turn, you can make a melee or ranged attack with a second psychic blade as a Bonus Action on the same turn if your other hand is free to manifest it. The damage die of this bonus attack is 1d4 instead of 1d6.

features.name: Soul Blades
mechanics: Homing Strikes: if you make an attack roll with your Psychic Blade and miss the target, you can roll one Psionic Energy Die and add the number rolled to the attack roll. If this causes the attack to hit, the die is expended.

Psychic Teleportation: Bonus Action to manifest a Psychic Blade, expend 1 Psionic Energy Die and roll it, and throw the blade at an unoccupied space you can see within a number of feet equal to 10 times the number rolled. You then teleport to that space, and the blade vanishes.

features.name: Psychic Veil
mechanics: Magic action: gain the Invisible condition for 1 hour or until you dismiss this effect (no action required). The invisibility ends early immediately after you deal damage to a creature or force a creature to make a saving throw.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend 1 Psionic Energy Die to use it again.

features.name: Rend Mind
mechanics: When you use your Sneak Attack with your Psychic Blades, you can force the target to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your Proficiency Bonus).
On a failed save, the target has the Stunned condition for 1 minute; the Stunned target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend 3 Psionic Energy Dice to use it again.
